$comment: WHO DOES THE WORK ON THE MAC (owner, 3 Nov 2026: 'after today we need to default OpenAI and Claude just be the brains'). worker = Codex on her ChatGPT plan, hands-on work (edits, builds, repairs, landing). brain = Claude Code, planning, deciding, reviewing, brain writes. Read by scripts/lib/model-roles.mjs, which the local-job claimer and every duty use; nothing else picks a model. A kind or phase not listed here is brain (fail closed). See docs/AI_GOVERNANCE.md.

worker_route.$why: On a ChatGPT Plus plan, training on conversations is an account SETTING, not a contractual bar (migration 0187). A setting she or OpenAI can flip is not proof, so the worker route counts as training-permitting: text naming a committed LP, or carrying deal terms or fund figures, never goes to it. Only a recorded no-training contract (e.g. a ChatGPT Business/Enterprise workspace) may set this true.

$confidential_why: Owner ruling, 4 Nov 2026: private-model-only means ONLY (a) the names of LPs who have COMMITTED to a West Peek fund and (b) deal terms and fund figures. LP prospects, brand and TLC work are not confidential, so the bare words LP, limited partner and investor are not markers. A committed LP is recognised by the Worker from the commitment records and arrives on the job as private_model_only (src/worker/ai/committedLps.ts); the markers below catch deal terms and fund figures in the prompt and the job's files. Unreadable files still keep the turn on Claude.
